answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 8836 Country: MW Title: I MISSED ALMOST 10 YEARS ROJA OF RAMADAN SINCE I AM NOT AWARE OF THE PUNISHMENT OF IT.CAN I GIVE FIDIA FOR IT? WHAT IS THE FIDIA IN INDIA? Question: I MISSED ALMOST 10 YEARS ROJA OF RAMADAN SINCE I AM NOT AWARE OF THE PUNISHMENT OF IT.CAN I GIVE FIDIA FOR IT? WHAT IS THE FIDIA IN INDIA? Answer ID: 8836 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1466/1236=L/1429) If you are able to keep fast then you are not allowed to give fidyah (expiation), rather you should make qaza of the fasts. You should determine to make qaza of the fasts especially in winter days when the day duration is smaller. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
